Name: Chulupí ó Vilela
Location: Fuerte Gorriti near Rivadavia, Bermejo river, Argentine Chaco
Remark: Vocabulary of the engineer Juan (Giovanni) Pelleschi, collected among Vilelas living with Matacos at Fuerte Gorriti near Rivadavia (Pelleschi's letter quoted by Lafone p. 53; his Chaco journey is described in his Otto mesi nel Gran Ciacco, 1881), alphabetised and printed by S. A. Lafone Quevedo 1895 as a 'copia fiel de los apuntes de Pelleschi' (p. 40). 'Chulupí' here = Vilela/Chunupí, not Nivaclé.
